titles: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas

characters.name: Haruki Shiga
characters.description:
A guy who incidentally found a book in the hospital titled "Disease Coexistence Journal" which is owned by his classmate [Sakura Yamauchi](https://anilist.co/character/127118/Yamauchi-Sakura).

~!It is revealed in the last chapter of the novel that his name is Haruki Shiga (志賀春樹).!~

characters.name: Sakura Yamauchi
characters.description:
A high school student who suffers a pancreatic disease, having her lifespan cut in half. She has a diary called "Living with Dying" where she writes about her daily experiences, since her illness was first diagnosed. 

Despite her situation, she keeps her smile and even makes jokes about it.

~!She was later stabbed after being discharged from the hospital and sadly passed away.!~
